query.text: 请帮我照看家里的老人，如果她往洗衣机里放不该洗的东西，请及时提醒。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the elderly person at home, and remind her in time if she puts things in the washing machine that shouldn't be washed.

annotation.text_zh: 您把钱包放进洗衣机了，请拿出来。
annotation.text_en: You put your wallet in the washing machine. Please take it out.

annotation.text_zh: 钱包不能水洗，请快点拿出来吧。
annotation.text_en: The wallet isn't washable, please take it out quickly.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
